## Toxoplasma Plaque v4 (round 6, cpsam_v2, default)

`toxoplasma_plaque_v4` · Cellpose-SAM (cpsam_v2, Cellpose 4.0.9) · default in the `toxoplasma_plaque` family

Toxoplasma plaques in crystal-violet plaque-assay wells. Stock Cellpose-SAM was never trained on plaques and finds few of them, fewest on Gel Doc scans.

Other versions: [toxoplasma_plaque_v3](toxoplasma_plaque_v3.md) (alternative), [toxoplasma_plaque_v2](toxoplasma_plaque_v2.md), [toxoplasma_plaque_v1](toxoplasma_plaque_v1.md).

## Training data

663 curated plaque fields from four domains (published-figure wells, Gel Doc wells, lab plates, staged literature crops), 32,717 plaques; 335 train / 65 validation / 263 test.

Toxoplasma plaques from published-figure wells, Bio-Rad Gel Doc wells, lab plates and staged literature crops; round 6 splits, best of 190 epochs (epoch 140), base cpsam_v2.

## Notes

- The default plaque model since 2026-10-11, by the maintainer's rule that spaCR models build on cpsam_v2. It scores below toxoplasma_plaque_v3 on the same 263 held-out fields, through spacr.plaque.segment_plaque_image: F1 0.815 against 0.844, lower on every source (Gel Doc 0.804 against 0.913); v3 stays selectable.
- Fine-tuned from cpsam_v2 (2026-10-10). It replaces the first round-6 weights, fine-tuned from first-generation cpsam (sha256 00f4a86b...a0c171), which remain in the repository history.
- Above toxoplasma_plaque_v2 overall (0.799) and on Gel Doc wells, where v2 scores 0.013.
- Published-figure literature crops stay hard (F1 0.530).
- Re-scored 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth (spaCR pipeline call, defaults; receipt features/data/model_rescore_curated_gt_2026-10-11/receipt.json): strict hold-out, fields this model never saw, F1 0.765 at IoU 0.5 on n = 329 of 562 fields (n differs between models); common subset unseen by every plaque model, n = 114, F1 0.534 (95% bootstrap CI 0.440 to 0.625). Without the v3-seeded Gel Doc truth (n = 81): F1 0.459. Earlier numbers in this row are superseded by this re-score where they differ. 263-field set seen counts: v1 54, v2 178, v3 137, v4 0; GRA8 Plate1 (hold-out of v3) is the same physical plate as ReimagedPlate1 (training data of v4). Default unchanged.

## How to read these scores

- **Precision** is the share of objects the model reported that match a reference object; low precision means false detections. **Recall** is the share of reference objects the model found; low recall means missed objects.
- **F1** is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, so it is high only when both are. Either alone can look near-perfect: a model that reports one obvious object has high precision, and one that reports every dark blob has high recall.
- **IoU** (intersection over union) is the overlap between a predicted and a reference object divided by the area the two cover together. A score given at IoU 0.5 counts an object as found when that ratio reaches 0.5.
- **AJI** (aggregated Jaccard index) adds up the overlap of every matched pair and divides it by their combined area plus the area of unmatched objects, so merged, split and missed objects all lower it.
- **Dice** is twice the overlap divided by the predicted area plus the reference area.
- **Stock** is the base model named under Architecture, run without fine-tuning on the same images. **Difference** is this model's score minus stock's.
- A **hold-out** or **test** set is images kept out of training and used only for scoring. The re-score note says how many of its fields this model had not seen.
